tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 21 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du ba 'ag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka'’srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb spyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bee ro ska cog zhung / /gzhubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khra/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyu/na mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'byams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal ba4/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi bandi dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bzhes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi ṭa a du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgyusgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus (skal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig 5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sgyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang / paṇḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo wo po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba // rdo ༵ kau byed pa dab / 'a ༵ rnyi 'i dhi~X broba~X rdo/kā/dho sdu tshi rmi sa~X dī rjo sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu/rde ༵sa po~X ༵༵ ༵ gcod sna rjo zhe~X /ma~X sna ga~X ༵'i/ ltas dang bcas sku tsongs te dang / da/sna ༵ ga~X/ hūṃ na~X lki~Xsgong da ༵ rnyi nga ri bla sdu /sna dzi~X ༵ sbyi sna skri / hūṃ /rtesho hūṃ /rdesnye sbyi / ga 6 tsho rgyus gi ya ) reg ba | st+ri hūṃ /nt+rahūṃ sdi/rgye /rderderde/ — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed sto blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dzwa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi spyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bzhes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ārya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lanta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshe/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon padma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhas bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta pu khyu nanda dang pra yā mā nanda gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang wo gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni ra ṇa shrī dang puṇḍa badzra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du shambha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku barsā gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi stso shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /g.yin yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma/ bde legang(kyis/—10—

dgyes pa rdo rje'i lag len gsal bar byed pa dpal he ru ka dgyes pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brang bzhugs/ 58dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bi rū pa'i man ngag gong ma'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang ba bzhugs/ 83dgyes rdor mar lugs kyi khrid yig 'khrul med nges gsang zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/ 138dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i man ngag sbas pa mig 'byed tre tshegs bzhugs/ 199kyai rdo rje'i rdzogs rim sgron ma gcig pa'i khrid yig ye shes rab gsal bzhugs/ 216dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rdzogs rim de nyid bzhi ldan gyi khrid yig bzhugs/ 222phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i byin rlabs bzhugs/ 236
zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa bzhugs/ 241phyag rgya bzhi pa'i snying po'i man ngag rab gsal nges don snying po bzhugs/ 280phyag rgya bzhi pa'i snying po'i khyi ka bzhugs/ 288

he ru ka dgyes pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ rdza sti/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i lag len gsal byed/ dpal he ru ka dgyes par byed pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal ldan lhan cig skyes dga'i rol rtsed ni/ /zab gsal khrag 'thung dpal gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /gnyug ma'i rig mchog rdo rje bdag med de/ /'khor ba sgrol mdzad de la gus btud nas/ /bla ma mchog gi man ngag la brten cing / / rang gi mos pa gtso bor ma byas par/ khyud rgyal mchog gi dgongs don ji bzhin du/ /rtsa ba kha skong sbas pa'i lugs bshad bya/ shanti pa sogs ye shes zhabs lugs len/ /nā ro mai tri tom bhi chung ba sogs/ /gur brtag gcig tu bris la kha skong gzhan/ /mi thub sogs kyis rgyud sde sna tshogs blangs/ /mtsho skyes lugs la'ang 'khrugs sdebs mang du dgos/ /snga phyi bod la'ang 'dod lugs dpag tu med/ /de dag kun kyang byin rlabs che ldan zhing / /phyogs re nas ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa'ang lags/ /'on kyang gdul bya sna tshogs la/ /ston pas chos lam mtha' yas gsungs/ /rtsa bshad cha mthun rgyud rnams kyang / /cho ga gcig tu bsre mi dgos/ /'dir ni rgyud rkyang man ngag gi /lugs bzhin gsal bar bri bya ste/ /dpal ldan zhi ba sbas pa dang / /lha 'byung bla ma mchog las brgyud/ /de la don oṃ nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ /snying po dgyes rdor sgrub thabs dang / /gtor chog yum gyi sgrub thabs dang / /mdor bsdus he ru ka gsum gyi/ /sgrub thabs rgyas pa re re dang / /de bzhin 'bring dang bsdus pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs dang / /sa chog sta gon dkyil 'khor zhag /—/rdo mchod bdag 'jug dbang bskur dang / /slar

bsdu ba dang rab gnas dang / /spyin bsreg tshogs 'khor maṇḍal mchod/ /las tshogs phra mo'i rim pa dang / /rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa ste/ / lag len rim pa 'di shes nas/ khri / da rgyal bla ma mchog la zhus/ /de nas rtse gcig sgrubs gyur na/ dngos grub 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /mdor bstan pa'i sdoms so/ /de yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du 'gro bas/rang skad cig gis dgyes rdor du gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma la hū/de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/dkar mo ri dwags nas/ sku la 'byud pa nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ 3 med bzhi sogs spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ shā n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hū las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa hū gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur/ oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hu hū hū phaṭa swāhā/ de'i nang du e las chos 'byung dkar po/ de'i dbus su la las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ ra las me'i dkyil 'khor/ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnams brtsegs pa/ de'i dbus su rang gi rnam par shes pa gnas te/ 'byung bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang / phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i steng du sna —2—

tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/bdud bzhi 'gyel ba'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ nyi ma'i steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po kham ser/ nub tu nye dbang nag po/ byang du drag po dkar po byang shar du skyon rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/lto nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris dud kha rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du g.yon bskor gyi a ā nas/mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes zhes pa'i bar/ de gnyis kyi bar du hu las thod pa dang a las gri gug hū dang a gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog mthing nag zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/g.yas dkar g.yon dmar lhag ma rgyab zhal bzhi gnag pa/ steng zhal dud kha cher khros pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / thod skam lnga lngas dbu rgyan can/ mche ba'i myu gu bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ hu gi sgra sgrog cing 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i nang gi g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha mo dang bcas pa 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na —3—

rta/ gsum pa na bong bu/ bzhi par glang / lnga pa na rnga mong / drug pa na mi/bdun pa na sha ra bha/ brgyad pa na byi la/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu lha/gsum pa na rlud lha/ bzhi pa na me lha/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha/ bdun pa na gshin rje/ brgyad pa na nor bdag go /zhabs bzhi'i mdun ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pas tshangs pa dang drag po/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis dbang po dang nye dbang mnan pa/ sku la thal chen gyis nye bar byugs shing / rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang / mi mgo'i do shal can/sgeg pa dpa' ba nas/ ldan pa nyid ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ thal ba spangs pa/ gzhan bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hū las rdo rje sngon po lte bar hu gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las byung ba'i padma dmar po as mtshan pa/ oṃ badzra mahā dī ṣa sogs/ o padma su kha sogs/yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems las lha mo brgyad du gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du dbang po la sogs pa'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas ḍa ma ru dang / g.yon phag pa/ nub tu betta lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal dang / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ byang du lha sma rī ljang khu g.yas sprul/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis —4—

gang ba/ byang shar du puska sī sngo nag g.yas seng ge /g.yon dgra sta/ shar lhor shā bā rī dkar mo g.yas dge slong / g.yon 'bar gsil/ lho nub tu tsaṇḍa li sngo bsangs g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol/ nub byang du ḍombi ni khra mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ thams cad kyang g.yon rkyang gi gar stabs dang / mgo rlon gyi do shal can/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur te/ yab yum 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje'i nas/ma mdzad cig /lha mo brgyad po yang thig le la thim/ thig le de nyid hū dang a du gyur/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa skya'i bar gong bzhi/slar yang gong bzhi mkha' gsang byin gyis rlabs/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su yongs su zhu ste/ rdo rje lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ hū a ga rtsa ba gha pa shā la ḍa rnams su gyur/ de las gtso bo yab yum lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa rnams su gyur/ de rnams mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang / sems can thams cad kyi phung po lnga dang nyon mongs pa lnga dang 'byung ba bzhi nang gi khams bzhi rnams sbyangs/ ye shes lnga dang tshad med bzhi la bkod/ tshur 'dus lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ gtso bo yab yum rang nyid la thim ste —5—

bdag por bzhugs/ lha mo brgyad po phyogs mtshams kyi gdan la gnad pa ni/ shar du go ri nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX/ lha mo brgyad kyi thugs kar yang nyi ma'i gdan la gaX rtsa sogs/ thams cad kyi mig tu moX las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar shwe las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ snar khaX las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lcer raX las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar i las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte bar ni las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sa 'og spyod ma dkar mo'i thugs kar sku rdo rje oṃ/ mgrin par āXlas sa spyod ma dmar mo'i thugs kar yang gsung rdo rje āX snying gar huX las mkha' spyod ma nag mo'i thugs kar yang thugs rdo rje huX/ de thams cad gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaXdzaXhūX baX hoX slar yang snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX arghaX nas/ ni wi kyi'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi tiñtsa tu maX sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa thogs te dbang bskur/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i rdo rje glu blangs/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i mchod/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gur gum dang —6—

me tog gi char phab/ rnga bo che sgra sgrags/ shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba spyin par bya/ /oṃ badzre bha ba a bhi dzin hu/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ 'khor lo bzhir bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang bas/ rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag cing / gtso bo yab yum dang go rī dang / puska sī la mi bskyod pa/ tso rī dang shā bā rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ betta lī dang tsaṇḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lha sma rī dang shom bī ni la 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs kyis ma rdzo/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ bar 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa cung zad bsgom/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ aṣṭa dang / de ba pi tsu ci nus bzla/ 'khor gyi snying po ni/ skye rna u a phe / / glu( gi/ba/ mi/ tse( gi/rtsa ra mi/ tsho rna gi/ba ra mi/ glu( gi/gha hwa// tso( gi/pa hu/ tsho( gi/tshanā hu/ oṃ ā la hu/ oṃ uḍa hu/ ces pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de yang nā da'i bar du sbyangs te mi dmigs par bzhag /slar phyag gnyis pa'i he ru kar gyur/mig tu mo las nas/ 'dzin pa'o/ /dge ba bsngo/ snying po dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te dang po'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ gtor ma 'dus byas la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was 7—

sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ya las rlud / ra las me oṃ u hā las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum/ a las thod pa dkar po rnams brtsegs pa/ thod pa'i nang gi dbus su hu las sha chen dang dri chu/ shar du bhu las dri chen/ lhor a las rakta/ nub tu hi las byang sems/ byang du kha las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ shar lhor bhu las ba glang gi sha /lto nub tu hū las khyi'i sha /nub byang du hi las rta'i sha /byang shar du tra las glang po che'i sha /ha ho khyi lan gsum/dri dang kha dog dang ro nus ngan pa rnams bsal/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams/yongs su zhu ba'i rlangs pa hu las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po gyur/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun lan gsum babs shing / de nyid kyang rdzas rnams la thim/slar yang steng du oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ u hā/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dang rgya mtsho la sogs par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rnams bkug ste/ yi ge 'bru gsum zla ba dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang bdud rtsir zhu ste gtor ma la thim par gyur/ oṃ u hā lan gsum sogs ci rigs brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus pa dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam pa dang / srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha klu'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dza rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong lha klu dang bcas pa la reg pas/ skad cig gis 'od gsal du zhugs nas dgyes —8—

pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i rnam par bzhengs/ oṃ dzaXhūX baX hoXkhaX raX/ oṃ ni ri ti hūX khaX zhes chu gnyis dang / oṃ de ba pi tsu badzra i maX ba li grihā grihā ma ma shintaX rakta ñtsa ku ru huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis bcom ldan 'das la phul/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ oṃ a ni na khyu aX i maX sogs/ go rī gaX /tso rī tsaX/ bitta lī baX/ lha sma rī ghaX/ puska sri saX/ shā bā rī shaṃ /tsaṇḍasnyi laX/ ḍombi nī ḍaX/ zhes pa rnams la mgor tsho rna āXdang / mjug tu i maX sogs sbyar ba lan gsum mam re res phul/ phyi rol 'gyung po'i tshogs la dmigs te/ tsho( in da dza ma sogs lan gsum gyisaphul/ thams cad la thun mong du/ gong bzhin chu gnyis dang / oṃ badzra pukhye āXhūX swāhā/ de bzhin du ni bi bye'i bar dang / sha lta yang phul/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sogs dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma brgyad dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams ni/ /lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /nas/kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'phrin las gzhol/ kolla i ri 'i sogs rdo rje'i glu blangs/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ /sogs smon lam btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa la/su po stso me bha ba/ sha shwa to me bha ba/ hri da ya me/ a dhi tiṣṭha sarba sirnyi me sogs dang / mjug tu mu bsnan pa yi ge brgya dang bco lnga pas bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba'am/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /gal te tshul 'dis bdag med lha mo bco lnga bsgom par 'dod na/ rang skad cig —9—

gis bdag med mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba la aX/ de'i 'od zer gyi nas/mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang 'phar ma gnyis dang bcas pa'i lha snam shar dkar nas/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa nyis rim/ lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams dang / steng gi ya phugs kyi nang dang 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du zla ba'i gdan re re/ mtshams kyi pad 'dab nang ma bzhi la/ bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re dang / gzhan rnams kyi steng du mi ro'i gdan re re'o//dbus kyi gdan gyi nas/ bar du aX las gri gug aX gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa nas/ rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog mthing nag drag mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du ṭāX ga dkar po bsgreng ba/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang / mi mgo'i do shal can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / zla ba'i 'od 'phro zhing / zla ba'i rgyab yol can no/ /thugs ka nas ā li tshar bcu bzhi spros/ro gdan bcu bzhi'i steng du 'khod/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ kā li tshar bcu bzhi spros te de'i steng du 'bod pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ ā i/ yī u/ ā ṛ/ grwa '-i/ lī e/ e o/ au aX rnams spros te nyi zla rnams kyi bar du 'khod pa gri gug bcu bzhir gyur/ de rnams las 'od —10—

zer 'phros/ slar 'dus te thim/ so rbe'i gnas su de rnams gcig tu 'dres te yongs su gyur pa las/ nang gi shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor gsang ba'i dkar mo/nub chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du mkha' 'gro ma/ 'phar ma phyi ma'i 'dab ma la dbang ldan du puska sī/ mer ri khrod ma/ bden bral du gdol pa mo/ rlung du g.yung mo/ shar du go rī/ ltor tso rī/ nub tu besta lī/ byang du lha sma rī/ steng du mkha' spyod ma/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ de thams cad kyang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma dang mtshungs pa'i sku can no/ /rang gi snying ga nas/ 'dzin sems dpa' zla ba la gnas pa'i aX/ thams cad kyi mig tu nas/ rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag cing / gtso mo dang go rī dang / puska sī la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje ma dang tso rī dang shā bā rī dang sa spyod ma rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ gsang ba'i go rī dang bitta lī dang tsaṇḍa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lha sma rī dang shom bi nī dang chu'i rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' spyod ma rnams la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ bstod pa ni/ bud med kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur/ /phyag 'os thub pa pha rol phyin/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bar 'dir dang por nag po rab tu bsgom zhes sogs la bslab bo/ /bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ 8( aX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes gtso mo'i dang / skye( a ā i yī u lha ṛ grwa '-i lī e i tse( e( aX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags so/ /nye bar bsdu ba ni/ gong bzhin las slar yang rdo rje bdag med mar gyur/ ces 'don pa spo/ gtor chog gi skabs/ dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i rsha tu/ rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil —11—

'khordo ra zhes dang / gtor sngags gyi skabs/ de ba pi tsu badzra gyi thad du oṃ a ā nas/ oṃ a gi bar bcug pa kho nas gtso 'khor rnams la dus gcig tu 'bul ba dang / bstod pa'i skabs/ bud med kyis 'dul sogs khyad par ro/ /bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor sgom par 'dod na/ mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba zhig sgom pas chog pa las/ rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ rang skad cig gis dgyes rdor du zhes pa nas/ hu hū phaṭa swāhā/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su/ sna tshogs padma'i lte ba la/ nyin ma'i steng du ro'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la yang ro'i gdan re re/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du nas/ de gnyis kyi bar du hu las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa so sor rtogs pa'i nas/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ dbus su dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag drag po chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis sdang mig 'bar ba'i spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/phyag g.yas rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod khrag thugs kar zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar bdag med ma dang 'dra ba/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du go rī/ lhor tso rī/ nub tu bitta lī/ byang du bhasma rī/ byang shar du puska sī/ shar lhor shā bā rī/ lho nub tu tsaṇḍasnyi/ nub byang du sho sbu nī rnams nag mo gri gug thod pa kha ṭā ga bsnams pa/ g.yon rkyang gi stabs — 12—

kyis bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing / don bdag med ma'i skabs bzhin dran par bya'o/ /rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i nas/ gnas pa'i hu/ thams cad kyi mig tu nas/ he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzlas pa'i skabs/ o tre lo kya akṣi ba hu hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla ba dang / gtor ma'i skabs gtor sngags kyang / o tri lo kya a snye pa i ma ba li sogs 'don pa spo ba ni khyad par te/ gas snying po dgyes pa rdo rje bzhin byas pas legs par 'grub bo/ /sku dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o// //gsung gi he ru ka sgom par 'dod na'ang 'di nyid dang 'dra ba las/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ dbus su dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi sdang mig 'bar ba'i spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum rdo rje phag mo bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa la 'byud pa/g.yas 'og mas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon 'og mas skyes pa'i thod pa lha dang lha ma yin gyi khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i zhes pa nas/dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de man chad sku rdo rje'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ o dzwa la dzwa la sbyo hu hū hū phaṭa swāhā/ gtor sngags kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /gsung dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te lnga pa'o// //thugs kyi he ru ka sgom par 'dod pas/ ye shes te/ dbus su dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug sogs/ gyen du brdzes pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus sngo ba'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje — 13—

'phyar ba/ gnyis pa na gri gug /g.yon gyi dang po mdung rtse gsum pa/gnyis pa na dril bu/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis yum rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma bcom ldan 'das dang ma zhengs pa las/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis khams gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi ro gdan la gnas pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ zhes pa man chad sku'am gsung gi he ru ka dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badzra hū hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ste gtor sngags kyang rigs 'gre'o//de ltar na he ru ka gsum gyi skabs 'dir mngon rtogs rgyas pa'o/ /thugs dgyes pa rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te drug pa'o// //da ni he ru ka gsum po de dag gi mngon rtogs 'bring du sgoms par 'dod pas/sems can thams cad bde ba nas/ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i nang du pad nyi dang mi ro'i gdan/ rang gi snying gar ra las nyi ma'i steng du hu/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa hu gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka zhes mtshams sbyar la/ sku gsung thugs kyi he ru ka gsum po gang rigs gong bzhi gsal bto nas/ rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i nas/ hū/ mig tu mo las gti mug nas/ rdo rje bzhi rnam par dag cing mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog sogs kyis mchod/ gong bzhin bstod lhag ma sngar dang 'dra/gtor chog gi skabs su/ lha dgu ka la phul bas chog kyang / gtso rkyang la 'bul bar mos na/lha dgu'i zhes dang / lha mo rnams kyi gtor sngags bor bas chog go/he ru ka gsum gyi sgrub thabs 'bring po'i skabs te bdun pa'o// //—14—

bsdus pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ tshad med bzhi'i rjes la/ shā n+ya tas stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hū gi rnam pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka zhes mtshams sbyar nas gsum po gang rung du bskyed la/ rang gi snying gar nas/ skyo/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzadza hū ba ho man chad 'bring po'i skabs dang 'dra/ de ltar na 'bring bsdus gnyis la 'khor gyi lha tshogs sgom mi dgos so/ /he ru ka 'di gsum 'dam skyes sngon po 'dra ba'i mdog /yang na sngo dang nyi ma'i mdog /ces gsungs pa'i mthing ga'am/ smug nag gang mos pa zhig gi chog par gsal lo/ /de bzhin du gar stabs mdzad pa rnams la ro'am/ lha'i gdan gyi snying gar nyi zla'i gdan byed pa'ang rung zhing / snying po he ru ka la go rī sogs/ sgo mtshams la 'god pa dang /bdag med ma la pad 'dab rim gcig dang / go rī sogs lha snam la bkod kyang chog go /he ru ka gsum gyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa'i skabs te brgyad pa'o// //da ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/ dbyung ba nyid kyis lhung bar byed/ /zhes sogs ltar rlung phyir dbyung ba rngus mtha' can dang / nang du bcing dgang ba dang / kha spyor du gnas pa bum pa can dang / ma ning gi spyor ba gzhil ba ste/ de rnams lta stangs dang bcas pas legs par bslab pa ni/ phra mo'i sbyor ba yin la/ thig le'i rnal 'byor ni gtum mo ste/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi man ngag bzhin gsal 'debs pa las/ de yang lte ba 'khor lo dkar po/ snying ga'i nag po/ mgrin pa'i dmar po/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo ljang khu'am/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'am/ dkar dmar nag gsum 'dres pa/ dbus su rim pa bzhin du/ ā hu oṃ ha dmar ser dang sngo skya dang dmar po dang dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i mdog can — 15—

rnams gsal btang la/ thur sel gyi rlud gis bde ba bskul zhing / bum pa can ma ning gi rlud sbyor la brten nas/ chu tshod re re 'khor lo gzhan gsum la sems gtad cing / chu tshod dgu lte ba'i a yig la mnyam par 'jog pa'am/ de tsam bzhag par mi nus na chu srang gi grangs la de ltar sbyar te sgom/ de la gom nas dbu ma'i nang gi 'bar 'dzag la bslab pa ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /ci ste gtum mo bsdus pa bsgom par 'dod na/ lte ba'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du a thung dmar po la mnyam par 'jog pa ni khyad par ro/ /de dag ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /thun mtshams su snang ba thams cad la lha sku sgyu ma lta bur mos shing / dam tshig gi phyag rgya sgom pa'i nyams kyis yang yang rgyas btab pa na/ snang ba gang shar thams cad bde gsal stong ba gang rung gi grogs su gyur pa'i tshe/ de nyid kyi nyams bskyang bar bya ste chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yid kyis sgom pa'i rig ma'am/ padma can la sogs pa dngos kyi rig ma la brten pa dang / rten gyi dbang gis thabs las kyang ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngos bzung zhing / de las byung ba'i nyams bde stong la mnyam par 'jog pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de rnams kyi rlud sems dbu mar thim pa na 'dod chags chen po'i ye shes zhes bya ba rnam par mi rtog pa'i bde ba chen po'i sems dang / de las rang shar du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa shes bya thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ni/ phyag rgya chen po dngos yin la/ de'i rgyud bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / phyag rgya snga ma gsum dang / bya spyod thams cad dang / snang grags thams cad rnam par mi rtog pas zin par byed pa yang / rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming btags pa ste phyag rgya chen po'o/ /de yang rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i nges pas sgom ste/ de rnams kyi man ngag bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par bya zhing / go don ni rgyud kyi rgyal po las shes par bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te dgu pa'o// //— 16—

da ni dkyil 'khor gyi las rim rnams mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis brjod par bya ste/ de las cho ga dang / sta gon dang / dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang /dbang gi bya ba'i las dang / dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i cho ga ste drug las/ dang po ni/ rgyas par na spyi dang 'dra yang / mdor bsdus pa la mngon par dga' bas ni/ oṃ in da sogs kyis 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma btang la/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi//dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ /ces gsol ba bto/ sa'i lha mo las kyang bslang ba las/ mchod gtor phul nas/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol/ a mṛ ta bzlas la ba byung gis dkyil 'khor gyi sa la byug cing / dri bzang gis chus gtor la/ tse( bhu kha nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hū la hu/ oṃ me dhi ni badzir bha ba badzra banta hu/rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na badzra kro dha hū phaṭa/ ces brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir rang nyid 'dug la/ skyabs sems nas brtsams bzlas pa'i bar bya/oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha zhes dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo nam mkhar bteg /mchod bstod cung zad bya/rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur/ hū zhes snyems pa dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyis gzhi bcag par bya'o/ /spro na/ skye rna gha gha sogs phur gdab bya/ mthar tsho( rakta'i sngags kyi sa gzhi bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo/ /sa chog gi rim pa'i skabs te bcu pa'o// //gnyis pa sta gon la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ bdag bskyed rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ sa'i lha mo'i sta gon spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gsol btab kyi skabs/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la — 17—

bstim/ sa chog byas pa'i phyogs la khar sang nam mkhar bteg pa'i sa'i lha mo de sngon du ye shes pa'i tshul gyis bstim dgos so/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ rdul tsho ni 'dri na las thig btab pa'am/ min na'ang lha gnas ma 'chol par dgos pas/ nang bar lha mtshan 'bri sar dri bzang gi tshom bu'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ lag len bzhin mchod gtor bshams/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gnas su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i nas/thags bzang rigs dud kha rnams gan rkyal du gnas par gyur/ sa chog byas na/nam mkhar bteg pa'i lha spyan 'dren pa yin la/ sa chog ma byas pa'i phyogs la de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' khyab spyan 'dren pa blo yul du bzhug nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dza mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul la/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar du go rī nag mo nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /bar der mchod pa gsar du bshams yod na/ mchod pa byin rlabs mdor bsdus spyi dang mthun par bya/bsdu na/ hū las byung ba'i mchod pa nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ ā:hu zhes lan mang du brjod/ chu gnyis la gong du bshad pa'i sngags lan gsum re bzlas la/ de ba pi tsu lan bdun gyi mthar/ oṃ u hri pra ba ra sa tpa ra ar tha badzra argha pra ru swāhā/ zhes pa dang / spro na dkyil 'khor ba gzhan rnams kyi sngags kyi mthar yang de bzhin du —18—

sbyar te mchod yon phul/ de bzhin du/ arghaX gyi gnas su pu duX sbyar bas zhabs bsil phul/oṃ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang / /gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni/ /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags na/ /so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra chu āXhuX swāhā/ yid dga'i snying po ro mchog ldan/ /bdug spos bla re dri zhim 'di/ /bdag gis: /so sor: /dhu pe/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnams sel 'di/ /bdag gis: /so sor: /ā lo ke /gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i dri/ /skye gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag gis: /so sor: /rdo/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid 'ong dge /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag gis: /so sor: /ni bi tu/ de las gzhan yang sogs/ shasta/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyi zhal du tsho( āXhuX/ zhes dngos su rigs bdag la phul/ lha so so'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ mkha' gsang byin gyis rlabs pa yid kyis dran par byas nas/ tsho( sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā ba atpa ko3haX/ zhes gsang ba'i mar pa'o/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa 'grub/ khyu dang mi rgyu'i 'khor ba kun 'grub khyod/ /snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can byang chub ste/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa'i yid/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje he ru ka dpal bstod/ /ces bstod pa nga/nga lhan cig rol mo'i sgra bya zhing / spro na de'i rjes su mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyi shu pa sogs ji ltar rigs pas bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūṃ baX hoX mdun bskyed kyi dkyil —19—

'khor dang gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/phyogs skyong lha klu zhes pa man chad sngar dang 'dra ba las/ gshegs gsol gyi skabs gtor mgron 'jig rten pa rnams kho na gshegs su gsol ba yin no/ /de nas thod pa'i snod du sha chen gyi spos sbyar ba'am/ de ltar mos la/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /bdag med lhan cig yang dag sbyor/ /zhes sogs kyi snyan gsan phab/ oṃ badzra u tiṣṭha zhes rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag spyi bor ldog ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis phul/ spyan ma drangs kyi bar du 'dir bzhugs la bsrung ba chen po mdzad pa dang / nangs par dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlabs te/ bdag la byin gyis rlabs pa'am/ bdag slob mar bcas pa la byin gyis brlab tu gse(la/ zhes sogs ci rigs pas gsol ba btab/ rakta'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsrung bas bskor/gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni dbang bum dgu dang las bum gcig te bcu'am/ bsdu na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis legs par bkrus shing / gos gtsang ma dkar po'am ser pos g.yogs/ mgrin par srad bus lan bdun du dkris shing / gu gul gyis bdugs/ dri bzang gi chu gtsang mas bkang / rin po che lnga dang / sman lnga dang / 'bru sna lnga rnams blugs/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yang sbyar/ yal gas kha rgyan me tog 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhug /bum pa'i steng spo stegs bu gzhan du/ dung chos sam thod pa'i snod du mchod yon bshams/ de la mchod pa'ang bshams shing / mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ bskyed chog spyi dang —20—

'dra ba las/ bum pa dgu yod na dbus kyi bum par/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sogs dang / shar gyi bum par go rī nag mo sogs bskyed lugs rigs pas bsgre zhing / rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa gcig pu yin na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa zhes pa nas/ gan rkyal du gnas pa'i bar/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje nas/bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar du go rī nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dza chu gnyis phul/ dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ de'i rjes su slar yang chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams sngags kyi phul zhing / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ yab yum 'dod chags chen pos snyoms par zhugs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ste/ bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa dang / 'khor rnams kyi sngags ci rigs par bzla zhing / mthar a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags kyang bzla'o/ /de bzhi du/ las thams cad pa'i bum par hū las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa g.yas pa rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub bsdigs pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ o badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍali ha na ha na hu phaṭa/ brgya rtsa las mi nyung bar bzlas/ snga ma bzhin mchod la/ 'jigs pa'i hu sgra nges sgrog cing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsole ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs —21—

thams cad bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /mchod yon gyi lhag ma de rdzogs par blug la/ tsho( āXhuX zhes brjod/ 'di skad cig gis bskyed cing / ye shes pa spyan drangs pa med pas gshegs pa'am bzhugs pa gang yang mi dgos so/ /slob ma sta gon ni/mdor bsdu na/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gsal 'debs su bcug cing / dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /sogs gsol ba 'debs/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /sogs spro ba bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs rgyun bshags bya/snying po'i sngags kyis slob ma la bsrung ba byas/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bkod cing bdud rtsis thig le bya/ de la me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab rnams phul/ de nas so shing dor ba dang / khyor chu byin pa dang / bsrung skud byin pa dang / ku sha ster ba rnams dang / 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /zhes sogs brjod pa zab mo'i chos la spro ba bskyed pa dang / rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba rnams nges par bya la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur na/ trīgasol btab kyi sngon du nang dbang bskur ba dang / rmi lam brtag pa'i mthar rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba'i don spund nas/ dgongs gsol sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum/ de dag thams cad cho ga spyi dang 'dra'o/ /lhag gnas sta gon gyi skabs te bcu gcig pa'o// //gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba ni/ nangs par sngar langs te/ thig tshon rnams kyi mdun du mchod pa bshams/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ thig sto rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dang rdul tshon sngon po mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ oṃ las byung ba'i sogs gong bzhi sbyar/dkar po rnam snang gi: aX las byung ba'i: ser po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo —22—

bo/ dzi las byung ba'i: dmar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ kha las byung ba'i thig skud dang rdul tshon ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bo/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu dang rdul tshon badzra sa mā dza dza / ba ho lan bcu/ gnyis su med par thim/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ hu bhu a dzi kha zhes bzla zhing thig skud bsgril/ rje cho lji'i jo cho zhes thig sne slob ma la gtad/ dang por ye shes kyi thig thig chen brgyad btab/ tsho( badzra snyu tra sa ma ya ma tri kra ma hū/ zhes so/ /de nas las thig gi cha dbye bar bya ste/ de la yab kyi dkyil 'bo’ra ni 'phar ma gcig pa yin pas/ nang gi zlum thig phyi ma sgo bzhi'i tshangs thig dang 'brel ba'i thad/ rtsa thig la reg par gdab cing / rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor la ni 'phar ma gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ padma nyis rim du byas na ni/ zlum thig phyi ma yab kyi de dang 'dra ba las/ zlum thig nang ma ni g.yas g.yon du cha chung bcu pa'i steng nas bskor bar bya ba yin la/ pad 'dab rim pa phyi ma med pa la ni cha chung bcu pa'i zlum thig skor ba kho na'am/ bcu gnyis pa'i mtshams nas bskor ba ji ltar bde bas drang ngo / kha cig ni padma'i lte ba cha chung brgyad par byas nas/ 'dab ma'i thig la/ zlum po nang ma bcu pa dang / phyi ma bcu drug gi mtshams nas bskor bar 'dod de/ de thams cad mi 'gal bar mngon no/ /thig gi bya ba zin pa na/ tsho( badzra tsi tra sa ma ya hū/ zhes lan mang du bzlas nas/oṃ badzra be gā kra ma hū/ zhes rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgyas thig rnams bteg par mos la/slob dpon dbus su zhugs te/ hihi zhes sgo'i thad ka'i rtsa thig phyes/ dbus kyi phur khung rdul tshon gyis bgang zhing / dang por slob dpon gyis ji ltar rigs pa nas bri'o/ /de la snying po'i he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la dbus kyi mawo ma sna tshogs rdo rjes mawo pa'i thod pa nyid yin gyi/—23—

rgyud las ma gsungs pas gri gug 'bri mi dgos la/ sna tshogs rdo rje thabs dang thod khrag shes rab mtshon pa'i yum gyi mtshon don yang tshang ngo / / legs par bris zin pa na rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor bzhin du/ yig brgya lan mang du bzlas/ bod rnying pa rnams kyi lag len dang mthun par/ bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba dang / khrus gsol rnams kyang byas na legs par 'gyur zhing / mchod gtor dang rgyan bkram zhing / bum pa rnams kyang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor nas gtso bo'i bum pa shar sgo'i g.yas dang / las bum g.yon du bzhag /gzhan rnams lha rang rang so so'i gnas sam/ de dang de'i thad kyi phyi rol tu bzhag go /mi bde ba med na gtso bum yang dbus su 'jog par slob dpon snga ma rnams bzhed pa ltar bya la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jog par mi bde na/ bzhag par mos shing phyogs gzhan du bzhag kyang chog go /rnam rgyal bum pa gcig pu yin na/ lha so so'i sngags dang bcas thams cad du 'jog tshul byas nas/ mthar rang gnas su bzhag go /dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba'i skabs te bcu gnyis pa'o// //bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ 'di la bdag mdun tha dad du sgrub pa la mos na tha dad dang / gcig tu sgrub pa la mos na gcig tu ste/ dang po ltar na bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams legs par bskyed cing / de'i gtso bo dang bdag nyid dbyer med du mos shing / rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs te/bgegs bsal la lus nang du bcug /gsang ba'i padma nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spros te/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod cing gsol btab nas/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la gzhug /sta gon gyi lha dang bsre ba dang / dbang bskur ba rnams byed pa yin pa/ rdo rje gur sogs las rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud la cho ga rgyas pa 'os shing / de'i phyir 'dir yang de —24—

bzhin byed pa skyon dang bral ba'i lugs yin no/ /'on kyang brtag pa gnyis pa 'dir ni sgom pa kho na gtso bor gsungs shing / las kyi rim pa'i spros pa shin tu nyung ba dang / dkyil 'khor yang bsdus pa tsam bstan pa'i phyir/ snying po'i dgos don ma tshang ba med pa'i spros pa chung ba nyid bsngags pa yin pas/ 'dir yang bdag mdun dbyer med du sgrub pa nyid bzang ngo / /de ltar na 'di skad ces bya ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa dang / spro na skyabs 'gro sogs sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum yang byas la/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nas/ bsrung 'khor du gyur/ ces pa nas/ ra las dang / huX las dang / huX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rnams dor/ de'i nang du gzhal las khang nas/ gan rkyal du gnas pa/ dbus su thod pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ shar du gri gug /lhor ḍa ma sa nub tu rus sbal/ byang du sprul/ byang shar du seng ge khar lhor dge slong / lho nub tu 'khor lo/ nub byang du rdo rje rnams lha dgu'i bdag nyid du gnas par gyur/dbus kyi thod pa'i gnas su/ rang skad gcig gis dgyes rdor du gsal ba'i zhes pa nas/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa lo bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de nas/rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus/ lhag par gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX a mṛ ta lan gsum gyis bgegs bskrad/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa phul/ oṃ badzra aX gu sha dzaX.oX badzra pā sha hūX/ oṃ badzra hpho ṭa baX/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍi hoX zhes pa'am/ oṃ go rī dzaX oṃ tso rī hūX/ tsho( bitta lī baX/ oṃ lha sma rī hoX zhes pa gang rung gis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya'o/ /slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes nas/ sa mā —25—

dza gong bzhin bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa phul/ dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang snying ga'i nas/ bzlas pa'i bar du'ang sgrub thabs bzhin las/ rdzogs rim sgom pa dkyus la mi dgos so/ /bzlas pa ci rigs pa grub nas/ dkyil 'khordo ra gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang las kyi he ru ka phyag gnyis pa spros te mchod pa'i las mdzad par gyur/mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul tshul rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /de yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma bar chad bsrung ba'i don du re shig bzhag la/ bdag 'jug gi mthar gtong ba'am/ slob ma dbang bskur zin pa'i rjes su khang steng du gtor/ phyi rol gtor ma btang ba yin na/ de'i rjes thogs 'das gtor bto kyang rung ngo / /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni/ skabs 'di nyid du gtong ba'am/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod na lhag gtor dang lhan cig ga rta lnga ba las/ tshogs 'khor ra yang skabs 'dir bya'am/ bdag 'jug gi mthar byas kyang rung ngo / /de bzhin du sbyin bsreg kyang gnas skabs gnyis po 'dir bya ste/ de gnyis las kyang gtso bor skabs 'dir byed pa legs so/ /de bzhin du phyi rol gtor ma gtong na'ang /gnas skabs gnyis pa der bya la/ phyi rol gtor ma mtha' gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin no/ /'on kyang kho bo cag gi bla ma gsang sngags rig pa de dag 'di ltar bzhed de/ nang gtor 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa gnyis phul zhing / phyi rol tu ma btang bar/ bar 'dir sbyin bsreg gis lha rnams mnyes par byas/ de nas phyi rol ba'i gtor ma btang zhing / slar nang du 'ongs nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba yin la/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshe yo byad 'dzoms na/ slar yang sbyin bsreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor los lha mnyes par bya ste/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba yang yang gdab par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di nyid lag len du bzung bar bya'o/ /ci ste dus dang yo byad ma 'dzoms na sbyin bsreg dang tshogs 'khor 'di dag yid kyis sgom pa kho —26—

nas kyang rung ngo / /de'i dbang du byas nas 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar gyi/ sbyin bsreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo gnyis zin pa na/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu phyi rol gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas pa khyer/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hū las 'od zer 'phros te/ srid pa gsum gyi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong ba bcu lha klu'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par glu tshe badzra sa mā dza tsho te dza : / sogs kyis chu gnyis phul/ glu( in da dza ma sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ gong bzhin nyer spyod rol mo yang phul/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams ni/ /zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyi 'phrin las bcol/ bkra shis smon lam bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams kyang gong bzhin byas la/rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te gtor ma ring du btang ngo / /slob dpon gyis aṣṭa bzla zhing tshams rngam bya/ slar nang du 'ongs te las bum gyi chus nye reg byas te/ bdag 'jug gi bya ba la 'jug go /spros pa dor ba'i skabs 'dir sgo dbye ba la sogs pa yang mi dgos so/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i skabs te bcu gsum pa'o// //lnga pa la bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇḍal phul/ chos / rnams gzu gas brnyan lta bu ste/ /zhes pa nas/ kun gyi sgrib med mthong bar sho/ga /ces lan gsum/ ā kha bī ra hū gisamig dar btang / sngags de nyid kyis me tog bzungs a mṛ tas bgegs bskrad cing / lasabum gyis chus gtor/ gnas gsum du/ oṃ ā hū/ kye khyod su yin/ bdag ni rgyal ba'i sras so/ /snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ oṃ sarba yo ga sogs dang /oṃ su ra te sa ma ya sogs/ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hu 'es dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du bcug par —27—

gyur/ spro na phyogs bzhi phyag 'tshal bar byed/ rgyud las de nyid bsdus pa la kha 'phangs mdzad pa'i phyir mchog tu legs la/ bsdu na/ oṃ na ma te skyoX/ na mo mi skyoX/ na mo na ma huX swāhā/zhes pa 'di tsam gyis kyang chog go/de la phyogs bzhi nas phyag 'tshal gyi sngags ni/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pa snya nā ya atpa naX ni rgyu ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra satwa a dhi tiṣṭha maX/ zhes shar dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya atpa naX ni myu ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ratna a bhi shiñtsa māX/ zhes lho dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya utpa naX ni sde ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra dharma pra brta ya mi/ zhes nub phyogs dang / oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma naX atpa naX ni sde ta yā mi/sarba ta thā ga ta badzra karma ku ru maX/ zhes byang phyogs nas so/ /de'i rjes su dam bzhag rnam pa bzhi ni spyi dang 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'i thugs kar dgyes pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs spros te/ lus thams cad gang bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas sras dang khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa rnams dgyes rdor lha dgu'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs ste/ rang gi ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs te/gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ tiṣṭha mahā kro dha a be sha ya huX/ zhes drag tu bzla zhing /rdul gyi gos pa'i ras dang / byi la nag po'i brun gu gul dang bsres pa'i dud pas gdug /—28—

rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /tiṣṭha badzra/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'di/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang gang 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'bor du gyur cig /oX pra tiṣṭha badzra ho/ pra ti gro hā/ sogs/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod sogs mig dar dgrol/ he badzra pā khyo/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /sogs kyi blta bar bskul/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du gsal bar gyur/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyabs pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /ces lan gsum/a mṛ ta lan gsum dang / yungs kar gtor bas bgegs bskrad/ dbang rdzas la yang las bum gyis gsang gtor bya/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūX las rang nyid dpal he ru ka dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhes pa nas/ mtshungs pa'o/ /dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu yang hūX yig las byung ba'i mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyi ngo bor gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga nas/ rnga bo che'i sgra bsgrags te shis pa brjod par gyur/ oX phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ 'khri ñtsa huX zhes dbang bskur/stong pa'i ngang las aX yig las byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyi mtshan pa'i rin po che'i cod pan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur/ lkoX badzra ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi khiñtsa huX/ badzra ra ga ta badzra shā li ho/ zhes cod —29—

pan gyi dbang bskur/ gong bzhin chu dbang gi sngags kyi kyang brtan par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las dzi las rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje dbang / /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long / /zhes rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ chu dbang gis kyang brtan par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las kha las byung ba'i dril bu don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /zhos rdo rje'i skabs la 'don pa spo/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti stu a bhi khri ྅ mi hu/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya/ zhes dril bu'i dbang bskur/ chu dbang gis kyang brtan par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las bhu las byung ba'i me tog 'phreng ba rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu bsgrags/ /oṃ badzra satwa stu a bhi khiñtsa hu/badzra nā ma a bhi ṣi ka ta he shrī rbe mo rdo rje zhes ming gi dbang bskur/ chu dbang gis kyang brtan par byas/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na dbang rnam pa lnga po de bskur bas/phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lngar rnam par dag cing / nyon mongs pa lnga'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ 'byung ba lnga rnam par dag pa lha mo lnga/ dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa sems dpa' lnga/ yul lnga rnam par dag pa rdo rje ma lngar byin gyis rlabs/ bya ba las dang bcas pa yang khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung / rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs te snying gar 'khode/ rtsa sngags dang snying po lan gsum gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/—30—
