bcom ldan 'di la sogs sngags dbang ngo / /stong pa'i ngang las hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo can/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phang gnas/ khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bzungs/ /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi jebadzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa stuX dhwa ra yā mi badzra satwa hiXhi hi hi hi huX/ zhes rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byin pas/ phung khams dbang yul drug pa rnams rnam par dag te rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo can/ hūX las byung ba'i cang te thod pa kha ṭāX ga rnams he ru ka yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dang gnas/ kha ṭāX cang te lhung bzed dag /byin pa dpa' bo'i bzung bar bgyi/ /spyo pa ni spyod pa'i brtul zhugs te/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la brten nas dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du ma rdza phul nas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas kyang / /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun kyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /zhes lan gsum/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bdag gi lus rnam par sbyangs/ 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ dpal rdo rje 'a myong chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya —31—

drug gis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can du gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ shar gyi lha snam la dbang stegs rin po che'i khri rim pa gsum/ pad nyi'i gdan dang bcas pa la 'khod/ hū las byung ba'i rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin/ 'di ste sangs rgyas nas/ hi hu gi bar gong bzhi/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /sogs/ ā las byung ba'i dril bu rdo rje snyems ma'i ngo bo/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /sogs/ u srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag sogs/ shes rab ma lo bcu drug lon pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin par gyur/ de la yongs su 'khyud pa las byung ba'i ye shes thob ste/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la nas/ dbang du brjod/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zhes sogs sho lo kag /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ dbang gi lha rnams dang /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje lam nas yum gyi mkhar spros shing /de las dbang gi lha dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa rnams su gyur te/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs/dbang bskur rdo rje nas/ sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hu/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag /dbang rtags rdo rje 'chang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang nyid la thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ nyer spyod lngas kyang ma rdzo/ de'i rjes su bka' bsgo bar bya ste/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci —32—

yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyod do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi gnas/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi dngos/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ khams gsum sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ /zhes pa tsam gyis kyang chog la/ ci ste rgyas pa la mos na/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi rjes thogs su/ thams cad mnyam pa nyid ni dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ma nyams pa/ chos rjes su dran pa rdo rje'i thig /tshad med bzhi ni zur bzhi/ sgo bzhi ni rnam thar bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ni kha khyer bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni sgo khang bzhi/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga ni rtsigs pa rim pa lnga/ rgyan rnams ni byang chub yan lag bdun/ ka ba brgyad ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang / snying rjes spyan ni dmar po la/ /zhes pa nas/ gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dag pa'i spyan/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /nas/don yod gnas/ gzugs phung go rdir bshad pa ste/ /tshor ba la ni chom rkun ma/ /'du shes ro langs ma yin te/ /'du byed lha sma phyir rab grags/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /sa ni puska si zhes bshad/ nas/ rlud ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /zhes lha'i de kho na nyid dang / deng khyod rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pas/ slob dpon gyi bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ dkyil 'khor dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya dang / stangs stabs —33—

dang / 'dug stangs dang / bzlas brjod dang / spyin bsreg dang / mchod sbyin dang / rab tu gnas pa dang / dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / dbang bskur ba dang /zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / mngon spyod dang / dbab pa la sogs pa 'di dag gis gzhan la phan 'dogs dgos pa yin no/ /zhes pa ni slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid do/ /de nas lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang / mig thur/ me long /dril bu/mda' gzhu/ chos bshad rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba dang / lung ston pa dang / de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur/ /zhes sogs dbugs dbyung ba dang / gzengs bstod pa rnams kyang bya ste g.yin du shes so/ /de rnams kyi phyi rol gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor du/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrungs/ 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du byas/ de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai/ /sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ ā kha sogs kyis mig dar bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ thugs ka'i 'od zer kyi sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje nor bur brtan pa'i ye shes mngon du byas nas/ bde ba'i rten kun da lta bu de sbom po dang ming med kyis blangs nas/rang gi khar babs par gyur/ ji ltar 'das pa'i nas/ dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā hu/ a ho mahā su kha/ oṃ ā hū/ mig dar bsal/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob pas/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rlung gi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / dam tshig tu bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams —34—

sgrubs/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ gong bzhin gsol ba gdab/ mig dar bcings/ lha mo dga' spyin nas/ mchod pa dag tu bgyis/ /kun tu ru gyis rdo rje 'dzin/ /phyag rgya bde ba ldan pa khyer/ /kye sems dpa' chen po/ zhes brjod pas phyag rgya gtad/cung zad rgyas par spro na/ dri ba dri lan bya ste/ dpa' bo byang chub sems bza' ba//khyod ni spro bar yin nam ci/ /rigs lnga las ni byung ba yi/ /rig ma mchod pa rtag gus sam/ /bshang gci stobs dang khrag la sogs/ /bza' ba da lta yid ches sam/ /rjes su mthun smos dam tshig bzang / /ji ltar bde bar bu smros shig /ci gsung dam tshig brten par ni/ /lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ /zhes khas blangs/ e ma nga yi padma ni/ /nas/ rtag tu bzhus/sa/ thar ba brten cig ho/ /zhes pang du byon/ thabs dang shes rab rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ ye shes de nyid dbang bzhi'i don can/ rgyud rnam pa bzhi la gnas pa ste/ rgod pa dag pa slob dpon nyid/ /sogs dang / sna tshogs dang po'i dga' ba nyid/ /sogs sgro ka re re brjod/ mig dar bsal/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ yid kyi dri ma dag /lam las dang dam tshig gi phyag rgya sgom pa la dbang / dam tshig tu shes rab ma mi spangs pa yin/'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du byas/ de nas de'i rjes su gnang ba byin pa ni/ sna tshogs spangs pa'i skad cig la/ /bde ba chen po rnam par bzung / /ji srid byang chub bar du ni/ /sems can don bgyis rdo rje 'dzin/ /lho brjod/ dbang —35—

bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ 'di la mig dar bcings dgrol mi dgos/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /nas/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /spa brjod/ rang gi ye shes nyid du gyur/ /zhes sogs dang / 'di nyid ye shes chen po nyid/ /sogs dang / 'dod chags ma yin chags bral min//sogs kyi don yid la byas te mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang /dam tshig tu nges pa'i don gyi brtul zhugs brten/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du byas/ rjes kyi bya ba/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / maṇḍal dang yon 'bul ba rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i skabs te bcu bzhi pa'o// //gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ cho ga'i rim pa gong du bshad pa de kho na bzhin las/ lag len gyi khyad par cung zad mi 'dra ba rnams mthong ba brgyud pa dang dag las shes par bya'o/ /cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ dbang rdzas rigs lnga sogs lhar bskyed pa dang /spro na slob ma'ang rigs lnga'i ting nge 'dzin 'pho ba dang / yol ba'i nang bcug gi sngon du bgegs sbyang ba dang / dbang gi dngos bzhi'i mgor rnal 'byor drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba yang bya ste/ 'on kyang de dag nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin pas/ 'dir ma bshad de gzhan du shes so/ /lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba yang / 'dis 'don pa bsgyur te rtogs par bya ba yin la/ 'di dag thob pas he ru ka g.yin gsum shugs la thob par bzhed pa yin no/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs te bco lnga pa'o// //drug pa nye bar bsdu ba'i cho ga ni/ de ltar dbang bskur ba zin pa na/ slar yang sbyin —36—

bsreg gi cho ga'i lha mnyes par bya zhing / phyogs kyi gtor ma'am/ gong du bshad pa bzhin phyi rol gtor ma yang rgyas par btang ngo / /de'i rjes su mchod pa bshams/ sngon bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / nang mchod gsang mchod/ bstod pa bsdus pa dang bcas pa'ang sngon bzhin byas la/ bdag cag slo/ba mar bcas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ sems can thams cad dges pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig ces smon lam bto cing bskor ba lan gsum bya/ yid la 'dod pa'i don rnams gsol ba btab bo/ /yig brgya lan gsum/ ma sho tsho 'byar ba dang / sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ lkoX khyod kyis nas/ gsol/ oX āXhuX badzra muX zhes lan gsum gyis/ ye shes pa gshegs/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la thim/a kā ro / re mthar/ skye rna āXhūX muX zhes btags pas dkyil 'khor dbyi zhing / mgo la rdul tshon cung zad bzhug /tsho ( badzra gī 'e1 ta gī la ya sa sgro gī la na badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya huX huX huX hūX phaṭa ho/ zhes phur bu stung / oṃ ru ru slu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sa rgyu a the sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes 'o mas gtor/ rten gzhan yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren na skabs 'dir bya zhing / slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mjug tu sbyin bsreg dang / gtor ma dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang bya zhing / dge 'dun gyi ston mo dang / yul phyogs kyi skye bo rnams tshim par bya'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs la ni/ sa chog dang / thig tshon byin gyis brlabs pa dang / thig tshon gyi las dang /dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba rnams mi dgos pas/ bzod gsol gyi mjug kho nar/dkyil 'khor dang rten gzhan la yang brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba bsngo ba dang / bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs tsam bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bla ma'i zhal gyi rim pa ni/—37—

sku gsung thugs he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la yang mdzad de/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas cho ga thams cad snga ma bzhin du spyad pa las/ me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba'i rjes su/ mkha' nang du dkyil 'khor chen po sprul te/ nang dbang gi tshul gyi slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor der bcug ste/rdzas spangs pa'i dbang bskur ba yin te/ phyogs 'di la sa chog gi dkyil 'khor dang / sta gon gyi dkyil snyen ra nye bar bsdu ba'i tshe/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu ba kho na yin la/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor yang bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las gzhan pa med do/ /dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu 'phros dang bcas pa'i skabs ste bcu drug pa'o// //lha la dbang bskur ba rab gnas kyi cho ga ni/ mdo tsam du na/ gong du bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de dag las/ gang yang rung ba zhig gis bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho gas kyang /'di la mi rung ba'i gnas skabs med do/ /de yang sta gon lhag gnas kyi rim pa sngar bzhin byas la/ rab tu gnas par bya ba la/ bgegs sbyang po ni/ bod rnying pa rnams kyi lag len bzhin du bya la/ de ma thag tu/ tsho( ā rna ta krita hu/ yang hu lan bdun bzlas te/ oṃ sarba pā pa da ha na badzra ya/ badzra satwa gya sarba bā pa da ha na swāhā/ zhes yungs dkar ram til bskor te me la dor/ oṃ hu tra hi a/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swāhā/ oṃ hu tra hri kha kha/ zhes dri bzang dang / 'dag rdzas ci 'byor ba dang / chu gtsang gis dngos su bkru bar 'os pa rnams legs par bkru zhing / bris sku dang glegs bam la sogs pa ni gzugs brnyan la bkru'o/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis khrus gsol bar mos la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod cing / a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags dang las bum gyis khrus gsol la/ sku phyes dang dris byugs pa dang na bza' 'bul ba rnams bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems —38—

dpa' gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rab tu gnas bya'i steng gi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX padma ka ma la ye stuX/arghaX nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan lha rdo rje mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po khyed la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyor dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod phyir dang / /sems can bsod nams spel don dang / /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid che/ khyed kyis rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /ga 'kho/ yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang gzhan rdo rje spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje can chen rnye bdag /rnye rab tu gnas pa ni/ /bgyi'o des na khyed rnams kyi/ /nye bar gnas par mdzad pa'i rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan phab/ rigs lnga'i bstod pas bstod/ oṃ badzra pu ṇa ra ga ma na ya muX zhes gshegs su gsol/ sku gzugs kyi gnas gsum la sogs par/ a mṛ ta'i sngags kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas dri bzang byugs/ phyi nang gi gtor ma rgya cher bto ngo / /de dag ni sta gon gyi bya ba'o/ /nangs par bdag 'jug yan ho kyi bya ba rnams zin pa na/ sngar bzhin las bum gyis khrus gsol/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha de nyid kyi bskyed chog shes na de ltar bya la/ mi shes na mchod rten dang / chags bral gyi sku gzugs rnams dang / gtsug lag khang la sogs pa ni rnam snang du —39—

bskyed/ glegs bam dang yig 'khru ni 'od dpag med dang / phyag mtshan rnams mi bskyod pa dang /slob dpon dang sku gzugs gzhan rnams ni rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de/ skye mched drug dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa dang / mchod bstod dang gsol ba lan gsum gdab pa gong bzhin byas la/ sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa ltar dbang lha spyan 'dren/ bkra shis kyi glu blang ba ni rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa brjod la/ chu cod pan rdo rje'i dril bu ming /slar yang slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du chu dbang bskur nas/ su pra pa 'i bar dang / gsang dbang shes rab ye shes bzhi pa rnams la gsol btab dang / rtogs bskyed dang / mig dar bcings grol dang / dri ba dri lan rnams dor nas/ dngos gzhi rnams bdag 'jug bzhin dbang bskur la/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o/ /oṃ badzra wa sa gya hū sogs/ oṃ ā sarba a bha ra ṇa bi bhu kho khyu/ swāhā/ oṃ dzo swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyis gos dang rgyan dang 'bras bu la sogs pa phul/ oṃ tsakṣu tsakṣu sa manta tsakṣu bi phe/ dha ni swāhā/ zhes mig thur gyis spyan dbye zhing mig sman bku ba'i tshul du bya'o/ /de nas zhi ba la sogs pa'i sbyin bsreg byas la/oṃ di bya asna sa ma sidha na bri ṇa ne swāhā/ zhes pas sbyin bsreg gi me'i lhag ma la 'o thug sgrubs te gzugs brnyan shar ba'i lha'i zhal du 'bul bar bya'o/ /oṃ hū tra hi azhes lan mang du bzlas la/ lha de nyid bskyed pa yin na ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams zhal bsgyur la rang rang gi gzugs su blta'o/ /de nas yun ring du bzhugs pa'i don du gsol ba gdabs pa ni/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni rab bzhugs rnams/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs la/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa —40—

dang / /sems can kun gyi don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor ba nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor ba yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun kyis 'di la byin rlabs shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs pa'i rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ spro na lag len bzhin tshig lhug pas kyang bya/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas la me tog dor de/ de nas rdo rje gsor zhing bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags lan bdun bzlas la/ de nyid lnga pa'am/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs kyi bstod pa glur blang ngo / /bsdu na/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun/ /las kun rab tu grub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ /zhes bstod/ yig brgya lan mang du bzlas te lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs par brjod/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dag /gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la//nongs gyur de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /kun tu zhi dang rgyas pa sa /yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs pa dang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /sa dang chu dang me rlung las/ /lha rnams kyis ni sku gzugs la/ /bskal pa brgya ru bsrung ba dang / /mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ /dgyes shing yid bzang gyur nas su/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi/ /bu dang tsha bo bsrung ba dang / /gang gnas dge par —41—

gde/gas su gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ mgron du byon pa'i lha rnams ci bder gshegs la bar 'dir chos skyong dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rgya cher gtong / slar yang sku gzugs la mchod pa rgya chen po dang / shis brjod sogs rgya cher bya'o/ /bgrang 'phreng rab tu gnas pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ dzi las 'od dpag med yab yum du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod byas la/ de zhu bas bgrang 'phreng du gyur/ oṃ ā dzi hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rnam grangs gzhan mang po dag ni 'dir ma 4nad do/ /rab gnas kyi cho ga'i skabs te bcu bdun pa'o// //da ni sbyin bsreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus pa bshad par bya ste/ de yang gong du bshad pa bzhin gyi sa chog las/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom mi dgos te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal tsam la gnas pas bya'o/ /der zhi ba'i thab khung bya ba ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa dpangs ji ltar rigs pa la/ dbus su thab khung zabs su mtho gang / rgyar khru gang zlum po la/dbus kyi mthil du padma 'dab brgyad rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan can bya/ mchu sor bzhis bskor ba la ze 'bru 'bri/ kha khyer dpang dang rgyar sor bzhi pa la/ pang 'dab 'bri ste phyogs bzhir rdo rje rgya khram gyis mtshan pa/ stegs bu'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyi nang thams cad dkar pos byugs/ sgrub pa po'i gdan gyi g.yon du chu gnyis dang bum pa bca'/ g.yas su bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang / de'i phyi rol tu me lha'i mchod pa rnams bshams/ gtor ma yang ji ltar bde bar bzhag /kai la sha yang brtsigs la/ rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs rnams rang gi mdun du bsham mo/ /de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bsgom la/ las bum sgrubs/ bum pa med na bsang chu sgrub te/ dung gi chu la 'khyil pa bzlas —42—

pas so/ /de nas nang mchod kyi rdzas rnams bsangs/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/skye rtso ā swāhā/ tso( dzi swāhā/ tsho( ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs/ tsho( ā hū dang / a rmi ta bzlas pas me bcug la/ tsho( dzwa la dza la hu/ zhesabarjod/ hū bdun gyis rlung yab g.yab/ a mṛ ta lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gcig phul/ oṃ badzra satwa ā zhes ku sha bkrams par mos/ thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhu las byung ba'i thab khung gi dbus su/ 'bar ba'i me ra las byung ba'i me lha dkar po ra skyes la chibs pa/ bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ me lha 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dza thal mo'i mthe bong g.yab pa'am/ dbyug gu rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing /oṃ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /snying rjes sems can don kun mdzad/ /'dir ni yang dag mnyes par mdzod/ /ces brjod la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ dza / ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ sgrub thabs bzhin dbang bskur la rnam snang gi dbu brgyan/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bos pa 'bul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭaklis dbang bskur ba/ khres rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ oṃ asna ye ā di be ā di be ā bi sha ā bi sha mahā/ shrī ye ha bya ka bya bsna ya swāhā/oṃ asna ye swāhā/ zhes dgang blugs lan bdun sogs ji ltar rigs pa phul/ na ma sa manta brnya na oṃ asna ye swāhā/ zhes pas bsreg rdzas mtha' dag 'bul zhing / de nas slar yang bsregs blugs gcig phul te/ yang thab kyi me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las —43—

gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa yan chad sgrub thabs dang 'dra/ 'on kyang 'byung bzhi la rang sems bsre mi dgos/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du huX dang aX las bcom ldan 'das dpal/ sogs dang / shar du gaX las go rī sogs/ mig tu moX las nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo na bza' nang mchod gsang mchod bstod pa rnams rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bar byas la/ mgor de ba pi tsu dang / mjug tu/ ma ma shi steng rakta na tsa ku ru sarba a the sā bhā ya swāhā/zhes pa sbyar la/ bar du rdzas sngags re dang spel ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ 'a ye swāhā/ mar dang / oṃ badzra la ta ye swāhā 'am oṃ bo dhi prikṣa ye swāhā/ gang wo gis yam shing / oX sarba pā paX da ha na badzra ye swāhā/ til/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/oṃ badzra pu gi ye swāhā/ 'bras ma brugs pa dang / oṃ sarba saX pa de swāhā/ zas mchog /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ ku sha /oṃ badzra bi dza ye swāhā/ 'bras so ba/ oX mahā be ga ya swāhā/ nas/ oṃ mahā ba la ye swāhā/ sran ma/ oṃ badzra lha sma ri swāhā/ gro ste de ltar na bsregs rdzas so sor ci rigs pa 'bul la/ mdor bsdu na lha sngags kho nas phul kyang rung ngo / /de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams gtor ma'i cho gas tshims par byas la/ mchod bstod/ gsol gdab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba rnams bya'o/ /slar yang me lha thab khung du byon pa la/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams phul nas/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ asna ye ā dī bya/ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ khyuX dhwaX zhes btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis bsngags nas blugs gzar gyis blangs te thab khung du 'bul/ slar yang sngon bzhin dgang blugs phul la/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol —44—

gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ me lha spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya phyir bkyed cing / swa arba na zhes sogs sam/ yang na bod skad du bya ste/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrubs kyi bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar byon cig /bdag la dngos grub thams cad mdzod/ /ces dang / me lha'i sngags kyi mthar/o mu zhes brjod/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /'di ni zhi ba'i cho ga snying po tsam ste/las gzhan yang 'di las dpags te rtogs par bya'o/ /sbyin bsreg gi skabs te bco brgyad pa'o// //de ltar na bshad zin pa'i dbang bskur ba dang / rab tu gnas pa dang / spyin bsreg la sogs pa 'di rnams mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i cho ga rgyas pa rnams legs par shes pas bsdus pa'i khyad par 'di dag nges par bya dgos so/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba mdo tsam ni/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba ni spyod pa'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'dir las dang po pa rnams kyi rim pa ltar na/ dang por yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs zhu 'bul rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ ji skad bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams las bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bya/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor rang nyid la bsdu'o/ /de'i 'og tu mdun bskyed ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba maṇḍal gyi cho ga dang 'dra bar bya/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phud dang po bshams te/'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor sngags kyis phul/ de nas/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la the tshom byar mi rung / /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ /rang bzhin gcig pa'i lhan cig rol/ /ces drangs/ de rnams kyis kyang / bde bar gshegs shig chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma rnam —45—

par spangs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes blangs te thams cad la brims/ lhag ma snod cig tu bzhag go/de nasaso so'i nas phud bsdus la de yang snga ma lhar 'bul lo/ /de ltar tshims par longs spyad/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la kha phrus btab cing / sngar gyi lhag ma cig shos dang lhan cig 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ku ru ku ru khyuXwarta li warta li/ mahā warta li tshe/ dur khrod gnas mo dngos grub zhal/ khrag la dga' ma yi dwags gdong / /gtum mo gtsigs byed khro mo ste/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha' dam tshig bsrungs/ /ki li ki li sgra sgrogs ma/ /pha mes nags nang gsol zhig bzhes/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa yi/ /gtum mo mche gtsigs dud sol ma/ /rang gi gnas su mdzod cig mdzod/ /hūX hūX hūX/ bzung zhig bzung zhig gdug can kun/ /zo zhig zo zhig ho rlu/ bdag cag rnams kyi sarba spre shanti ku ru ku ru phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang / kyi5 kā ro'i sngags kyis lan gsum bsngos la/ tso ( kha kha ji hi ji hi 5gi tsi ni bā li ta bhakṣa si swāhā/ zhes pas lhag gtor btang / las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ yang rdo rje'i glu blangs te spro na gar la sogs pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /zhes sogs sho lo ka snyag brjod cing don bsam/ a nu rā ga'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bldan /rigs su skye dang sogs smon lam gdab cing / rgyud gzhan las gsungs pas kyang smon lam btab la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod do/ /tshogs kyi 'bor lo'i skabs te bcu dgu pa'o// //maṇḍal mchod pa'am/ phyi rol mchod pa ni/ zhu 'bul ma gtogs bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ maṇḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ra las nyi ma'i nas/ gan rkyal —46—

du gnas pa/ oṃ he badzra ya na ma o nai rwa khyu ya na ma oṃ go rī na masogs kyis byin gyis bsas/ o de ba pi tsu badzra hu hū phaṭa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka dgyes pa rdo rje nas/ mtshungs pa'o/ /oṃ ā ga hū/ shar du go rī nag mo/ zhes sogs sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi mig tu zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams bya ste dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i skabs dang 'dra/ yan lag bdun pa dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzungs rnams bya ste/ thugs brgyud bskul ba'i don du bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ slar yang mchod bstod nas bkra shis kyi bar rjes chog rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di la 'grub cing spro na/ mchod pa'i skabs su lha re re'i sngags kyi mthar/ mchod pa'i sngags re btags te phul na shin tu legs so/ /phyi rol mchod pa'i skabs te nyi shu pa'o// //da ni las tshogs sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor rnams bshad par bya ste/ de yang dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ rang gi snying gar ā las rdo rje ma dkar mo gri thod kha ṭā rnams 'dzin pa/ thugs kar hū yig can sgom ste/ o hū swāhā/ 'bum phrag gcig gam bzhi 'bum du bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de nas kham phor kha sbyor la thod le skor gyis 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba la/ oṃ hu rnye mo stam bha ya stam bha ya hu swāhā/ mtha' skor du sa yig gis skor ba bris/ rtsibs brgyad la/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha mu khyud la sa yig gam rtsa sngags spel tshig can bris/ kha phor gzhan sna tshogs rdo rje dang ri rab bris pa'i steng nas bkab/ de rdog pas mnan te sngags spel tshigs can khri bzlas te/ des kyang ma 'grub na/ mchod rten la sogs par sba'o/ /'di ni spel tshig gi dbye bas lus rengs pa dang ngag rengs pa gnyis car byed do/ /—47—

de ba smi du/ i las go rī dmar ser lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa thugs kar a yig la bsgom la/ oṃ a swāhā/ bsnyen pa bya/ de nas bsgrub bya skra grol ba sogs mdun du bsam ste/ snying ga'am skye gnas su a yig dmar po las me 'bar te ha yig rab tu zhu bar bsam ste/ oṃ a rsha mo bdag gis dbang du bsdus shig a swāhā/ zhes zhags pa lcags kyu'i spyor bas bkug cing / 'khor lo 'bri ba ni gro ga la rgya skyegs kyis bri te/ sa gyi dod du tha yig go /de bzhi du/ i las chu'i rnal 'byor ma sngon mo tho ba dang sdigs mdzub can/ thugs kar kha yig go /oṃ kha swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas la/ 'khor lo rnga mo dang bya rog gi khrag gis bris la kha gis bskor ba rnga mo'i rgyab tu gnas pa'o/ /dgug gzhug drag tu byas te/ bsgrub bya gcer bu skra grol ba rnga mong la bskyon te khro bo dbyug pa thogs pas lho phyogs su gdas par bsam/ oṃ kha rnye mo u tsi ṭa ya kha hu hu hū phaṭa zhes bskrod pa'o/ /de bzhi du/ u las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nag mo ral gri dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa thugs kar dzi yig sgom la/ oṃ dzi swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas la/ 'khor lo rta dang ma he'am ji dang lug pa'i khrag gis 'bri ste dzi gis bskor ba'o/ /bsgrub bya dgug gzhug drag tu bya zhing / phan tshun du srog chags de dag zhon zhing 'thab par bsam nas/ oṃ dzi rghaṃ mo dang rnye mo bi dī ṣa ya dzi hū hu hū phaṭa/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dbye ba 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du/ bdag med ma a las byung ba dud kha spyi dang 'dra bar bskyed la/ thugs kar bu yig sgom la/ oṃ bu swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas nas 'khor lo ni rims nad kyis shi ba'i thod pa la dug dang / khrag dang / nye tshe dang / lan tshwa rnams kyi 'dri ste/ lte bar zur drug pa la hu drug /bu gyis skor ba ni khyad par ro/ /bsgrub bya'i bya ba snga ma dang mtshungs pa las/ nyi phyed dang —48—

nam phyed phub ma'i me la gdung bar bya'o/ /oṃ bu smre mo rims kyis thebs par mjodi cig bu hū hū hu phaṭa/ rims kyis thebs par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ a las byung ba'i mkha' spyod ma dmar mo/ snying gar hu oṃ hu swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas la/ 'khor lo hū dang hi dzas bskor ba/ shing lo rlung gis khyer ba ma lhung pa la bris te/ rlung dang me'i steng du bsgrub bya myos par bsam/ snying ga nas 'od zer dmar po spros/ bsgrub bya'i sna sgo g.yas pa nas zhugs/ snying ga nas bcud phrogs te sna g.yon nas byung /rang gi snying gar thim/ dbugs kyi rlud gis bkug par bsams la/ glu( hū lha mo ā karṣa ya hu hri dza zhes pas 'gugs pa'o/ /yang / e( las sa spyod ma nag mo ches 'khru/gas pa/ snying gar ghu/ oṃ pu swāhā/ bsnyen pa byas nas/ ro ras sam mi'i lpags pa la rims kyi 'debs pa'i skabs dang mtshungs par 'khor lo 'dri ba las/ bu gyi dod du tsho bris/ de nyid bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang / mi ro bsregs pa'i thal ba bsres nas/ gzugs brnyan byas te snying gar bcug/dug dang khrag dang tsher ma rnon pos btab/ ro skra'i dkris te 'brub khung du bzhag /mngon spyod kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ oṃ tsho rghaṃ mo mā ra ya tsho hu hū hu phaṭa/ ces bzla zhing drag po'i rdzas kyis yang yang brab/ khugs pa dang bral ba'i mtshan ma gsal por mthong na/ rdo rje me khab kyi spyor ba dang bcas te drag tu bzlas pas gsod par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste ma grub na thod pa kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug ste/ dur khrod du sbas na 'grub bo/ /'khor lo 'di ni char 'bebs pa dang /rims kyis 'debs pa dang / rab tu myos la dbang du bya ba rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du/ ku ru kulle sgrub pa yang tshad med bzhi dang / stong pa dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sngon du 'gro bas/ gong he ru ka gsum gyi skabs su bshad pa'i cho ga de nyid sbyar la/ oṃ ku —49—

ru kulle hi swāhā/ zhes bsnyen pa byas nas/ 'khor lo'i lte bar hi rsha mo ā karṣa ya hi dza'adab ma brgyad la ku ru kulle lha swāhā/ 'khor yug tu hi dzus bskor ba bris la/ dbang dang dgug pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin du sgrubs na/ de dag thogs pa med par 'grub cing / 'di ni las thams cad byed pa'ang yin no/ /grong khyer bskyed pa'i 'khor lo ni/ 'khor lo'i lte ba la spel tshig ming yig dang bcas pa bris/ 'dab brgyad kyi yi ge brgyad la/ spel tshigs re res bskor ba dang / lte ba'i mtha' skor du rnal 'byor ma'i sngags phreng dang / mu khyud dang po la rtsa sngags/ gnyis pa la ā li/ gsum pa la kā li/ bzhi pa la bskul sngags kyis bskor ba bris/de nyid mang por byas la/ rab tu brtsegs pa thod pa kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug la/ bskrod pa'am dbye ba'i tshul gyis sgrubs na/ grong bsgrod pa dang grong 'thab par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo 'dis las thams cad sgrub par bshad de/ des na gong du bshad pa'i las bdun dang / ku ru kulle dang / 'di ste dgu po 'di ni rnal 'byor ma'i las gtso bo che ba yin no/ /char 'bebs gcod gnyis/ rdo rje gri gug gi spyor ba/ nyi zla mnan pa/ rims kyis 'debs pa rnams he ru ka'i las gtso che zhing / lhag ma rnams cha mnyam pa'o/ /las 'di kun yang sbyin bsreg dang gtor mas las kyi grogs byed pa mang la/ spyin bsreg las rigs dang bstun cing / gtor ma'i cho ga gong du 4nad pa'i gtor ma rṣa pos kyang sgrub dgos la/ so so'i bsnyen pa'i skabs su ni bsdus pa ste/ 'jig rten 'das pa la sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa dang / 'jig rten pa rnams la a kā ro'i sngags nyer gcig gis 'bul ba yin no//ci ste las kyi lha rnams snying gar sgom pa la mi mos na mdun du'o/ /las tshogs kyi skabs te nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //da ni rnal 'byor 'grub pa'i rim pa spund par bya ste/ dang po slob dpon dang slob ma'i —50—

mtshan nyid shes pas dbang bskur ba thob par bya'o/ /des ni rtag tu dam tshig la gnas dgos pas dam tshig gi rim pa dang / de nas bskyed rim dang / bzlas pa dang / stong pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom par byed dgos la/ de dag cung zad brtan pa rnams kyis/ las bzhi sogs thogs pa med par 'grub cing / nyi zla gnon pa sogs sgyu 'phrul gyi rig sngags rnams kyang rim gyis 'grub bo/ /gal te 'dir spyod pa spyad na thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams kyang 'grub cing /skye ba bdun pa'i dam tshig la sogs pas kyang 'grub pa yod la/ 'on kyang dngos grub mchog tshe 'di nyid la sgrub par 'dod pa rnams kyis ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob na ni legs/ma thob kyang rim gnyis lhan cig tu bsgoms pas/ brtan pa yang lhan cig thob pa yod de/ de la dang por rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis lus sbyangs bar bya zhing / phyi nas phyag rgya bzhi'i rnal 'byor la brten te sgom pas/ myur du drod thob par 'gyur la/ de nas dngos grub myur du thob par 'dod na/ spyod pa spyad dgos so/ /de yang dang por zla ba gcig kun 'dar gsang ste spyod pa spyad pas/ ye shes 'phel bar gyur na ni/ rang gi nus pas bkug pa'am/ sbyang ba las byung ba'am/lung bstan pa las thob pa'i grub pa'i phyag rgya yang rnyed par 'gyur la/ de nas kun 'dar 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa ni/ brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u bzhi pa las/ rang byin gyis rlabs pa'i spyod par gsungs pa bzhin spyad do/ /de'i tshe gzhan don spyod pa'i nus pa mchog dang ldan par 'gyur na/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa spyad de/ he ru ka'i mas su zhugs shing grub pa'i phyag rgya dang lhan rnacig 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas rtsen par byed pa ni/ brtag pa dang po'i le'u drug par bshad pa bzhin no/ /de'i zhing rnams su yongs su rgyu bas/ nang gi rtsa rnams rab tu dag ste/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /spyod pa de dag gi gnas skabs su spros bcas kyi spyod pa la mos pa rnams ni/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub par byed de/ rgyud g.yin las kyang /—51—

nyin re'am zla ba re re'am/ /de bzhin lo ni re rer yang / /ji bzhin cho gas byin rlabs nas/ /sangs rgyas bde mchog gar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su/ dur khrod kyi ras la pad nyi'i gdan bris pa'am/ stag lpags sam/ mi ro'i gdan nam gzugs brnyan lha grangs dang mnyam zhing / 'god tshul mthun par bshams/ de yang rgyas pa sgrub pa po he ru ka dang / phyag rgya lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'bring bo ni rig ma dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang / rig ma brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ bsdus pa ni rdo rje gur las lha lnga ma yang gsungs pa dang / dngos su phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor yang slob dpon rnams 'dod pa ltar 'byung ngo / /de la ngo bo ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba yin la/ bskyed rim gyi spyod pa yin na ni sgom pa'i rim pa yang bskyed rim gyi sgrub thabs bzhin yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i spyod pa la ni/ bde ba dam pa lha skur rang shar ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa nyid do/ /'di ni gtso bor kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i skabs su byed pa mang ngo / /ci ste phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub chung du thob na ni/ 'phags par gyur pa yin la/ de nas phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa spyad pas/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i ye shes gong nas gong du gyur pa las/ 'phags pa'i sa rnams bgrod de dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur 'gyur ro/ /de ltar thob pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba'i sems/ de bzhin nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i dag pa dang / lha so so'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dag pa/ rang rig pa bde ba chen po'i dag pas/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa yin pa'i phyir/ lam rnam pa gsum sgom pas dag pa gsum po re rer yang / glo bur gyi dri ma bral te dag pa gnyis ldan du 'gyur ro/ /de yang lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa de yang / rigs lnga dang phung po lnga dang khams lnga la sogs pa'i dbye bas stong ba chen po lnga'am/bde ba chen po lnga zhes rnam par bzhag pa byas so/ /gdod ma nas sangs rgyas lnga'am drug gi ngo —52—

bor gnas pa de/ lam yang de ltar bsgom pas/ 'bras bu yang rigs lnga thob pa yin la/gdod nas sku bzhir gnas pa la/ lam rnam pa bzhi sgom pas/ 'bras bu yang sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de la 'bras bu ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' chos sku dang / sems dpa' chen po longs sku dang / dam tshig sems dpa' sprul sku dang / dgyes pa rdo rje bde ba chen po'i sku'o/ /gzhan yang rigs lnga nas rigs bgrang ba las 'das pa'i bar du yongs su ston par byed do/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi rim pa'i skabs te nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de ltar na gtso che ba'i don rnams bstan zin te/ da ni sngar mug da pa rnams su nye bar mkho ba'i bstod pas dkyil 'bor rṣa po la bstod pa ni 'di yin te/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag med mas ni mgul la 'khyud/ /dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /spyi bo'i steng na nag po mdzes/ /dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon/ /gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni/ /gnag pa de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /glang bo rta bong glang rnga mong / /mi dang sha ra bha byi la/ /skyes pa khyi dang ma he can/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sa dang chu dang rlung dang me/ /zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa/ /g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo bzhi yis bdag nyid —53—

mdzes/ /'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya lnga yis yang dag brgyan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin//dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid/ /dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob/ /bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ga las skyes pa'i go rī shar/ kha dog gnag cing g.yon pa nya/ /g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin/ /tshangs pa mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rtsa las skyes pa'i chom rkun ma/ /btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su/ /phyag na phag dang cang te bsnams/ /dab pa po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /ba las skyes pa'i ser mo nub/ /ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan/ /phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis/ /rus sbal bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lha sma rī ni byang gi sgor/ /ljang khu gha las byung ba yi/ /phyag na sbrul dang thod pas sbrel/ /drag po mnan la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gshin rje mnan cing pa las byung / /g.yon pa dgra sta seng ge g.yas/ /dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma/ /phyag 'tshal puska sī sngo la/ /ri khrod ma dkar sha las byung / /me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas/ /g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa yis/ /dge slong 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma/ /srin por rtsa las byung ba yi/ /g.yon na thong gshol 'khor lo g.yas/ /phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la'o/ /ḍi las 'khrungs pa'i g.yung mo ni/ /rlud mtshams thags bzang rigs steng gshegs/ /phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub g.yas rdo rje/ /sna tshogs mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /—54—

gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams ni rnam dag pa'i/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yi/ /bde rab ster 'di thams cad la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi phyag na bzung ba yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i/ /bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor gnas sa bon/ /gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /nyid kyi nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni/ /'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan/ /nyid las 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i/ /zhi ba'i bde stsol rig mar bsdud byed pa'i/ khres rab chags pas bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyi/ /gnas su zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro ma gtso dgyes rdo rje/ /lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog /ces pa 'di ni grub pa'i slob dpon mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa ste/ da ltar byed pa dang sbyar na/ skyes pa khyi dang ma he can/ /zhes pa/ mi dang rkang brgyad byi la ste/ /zhes dang / srin por rtsa las byung ba yi/ /zhes pa/ srin por la las byung pa yi/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur na legs so/ /bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni/shes rab pha rol phyin ma mchog /lha mo'i tshul gyis 'gro ba sgrol/ /lha cig skyes ma'i bde rgyas ma/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /zhe sdang rnam dag gsal ba'i dngos/ /rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa'i/ /chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma la 'dud/ /gzugs —55—

phung gti mug dag pa'i lha/ /me long ye shes rdo rje ma/ / tshor pa ser sna dag pa'i lha/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba'i go rdir 'dud/ /'du shes 'dod chags dag pa'i lha/ /sor rtog chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed phrag dog dag pa'i lha/ /bya sgrub rdo rje mkha' 'gror 'dud/ /sa khams ye shes byams pa che/ /puska sī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu khams ye shes snying rje che/ yā bā rī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me khams ye shes dga' ba che/ /tsaṇḍasnyi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rlud khams ye shes btang snyoms che/ /ḍombi nī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam dag rdo rje don dam gzugs/ /lha mo go rī la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag rdo rje don dam sgra/ /lha mo tso rī la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag rdo rje don ma dri/ /lha mo ro langs mar phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag rdo rje don dam ro/ /lha mo lha sma rir phyag 'tshal/ /don dam srid pa rdo rje'i reg /sa spyod ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don dam zhi ba chos kyi khams/ /mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde chen bdud rtsi lnga yi dngos/ /bum pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub brgyad po rnam dag pa'i/ /bkra shis bum pa brgyad la 'dud/ /byang chub phyogs mthun rnam dag pa/ /gzhal med khang la gus pa'i bstod/ /bdud rnams ma lus bcom pa'i dngos/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /ma mo 'dus pa nyams dga'i gnas/ /dur khrod gnas pa rnams la bstod/ /bstod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /rnal 'byor ma gtso thob par shog /ces pa'o/ /he ru ka gas gsum la bstod par 'dod na/ gong du bshad pa las bsdu bar bya ste/ thams cad dngos po'i sogs gas ca stog /sa khams ye shes —56—

sogs rlo ka bzhi/ phung po khams ni sogs gcig /gang zhig nyi zla sogs gsum byas pas legs par 'grub bo/ /bstod pa'i skabs te nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ rgyud sde kun gyi zab mo'i mthar thug pa/ /snying po'i don ston dgyes pa rdo rje yi/ /don gyi snying po lag len cho gar bcas/ /smra ba 'di yang bla ma mchog gi drin/ /gzhan 'dod mang po'i rjes su 'di ma 'brangs/ /gang ba'i rdo rje zhes bya'i slob dpon ni/ /rdo rje 'chang mtshungs de yi rim pa rnams/ /rgyud don dngos la 'byor phyir lhag par dang / /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'di sa /sngon byon grub thob rnams kyi dgongs pa'ang 'di/ /'on kyang rtog ge'i rjes 'brangs mkhas grags can/ /phyi rab mu cor smra rnams 'bras med shes/ /blo ldan rnams kyis bde blag rtogs pa'i phyir/ /'dus gsal tshang la go bde don bzang zhing / /ngag 'don bde 'di gus ldan don phyir bkod/ /rgyud kyi don 'grel 'dis ni dge legs 'gyur//zhes pa dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i lag len gsal bar byed pa/ dpal he ru ka dgyes par byed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ skal ldan 'phrin las dbang mo sogs snying po la mos pa'i don gnyer 'gas bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su'o// //ma ṅga la/ 'di la lha sta gon nas brtsams te/ dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod la sogs pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i zhabs kyi lugs 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil chog bde ba chen po'i char yang bzhin mdzad pas kha 'gengs pa man ngag yin no/ / zhus dag /ma ma bi dza ya sdu/—57—

gsung gi rjes 'brang bzhugs/bi rū pa'i lugs/oṃ snya sti/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brang zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgyes pa rdo rje he ru ka /rje btsun de la gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus zab mo ni/ /g.yin 'ga' rjes su bzung phyir bshad/ /de la 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i lam bskor du grags pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas/ re zhig yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ba la/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mnyam par ma ba6ga pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rims pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos —58—

rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lko pa ci rigs par brjod/ mjug tu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum bya/ de nas/rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hu las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hu dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hū las thim/bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka tī no pa rnge ḍi rnyo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/sarba sirnyi me pra yasmo sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsitta shri ya ku ru hu/ ha ha ha ha hobha ga wan badzra he ru ka /mā me mu sma he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa ā hū phaṭa/—59—

ces ci nus bzlas la thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba bto/ de nas/bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas/ spyi bo nas rang la thim/ rang skad cig gis kyai rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar pa las padma dang ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hu sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bawo gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas gtso bo'i dbu la brgyan pa/ o badzra sa mā dza na mo gu ru khyo na ma shrī he badzra maṇḍal bhyadakar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /lha sma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag/de bzhi ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la//byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub —60—

sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /wo lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rig mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun kyi —61—

don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ stong pa nyid bsgoms nas sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa utpa ko3ha/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pa las padma dang ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hu las sna tshogs rdo rje ra bcu gnyis pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hū gis mtshan pa/ hū las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hu hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ bsrung 'khor dngos ni de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas par spro ba'am zlog pa byed dgos na 'di ltar bya ste/ sna tsho gis rdo rje'i lte bar pa las padma dang / ra las nyi ma'i steng du/ bhu ser po las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ go skabs med par gyur/ oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa hu bhu hu/ lan gsum/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang / phyogs bcur padma dang / nyi me'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi nyi —62—

ma'i steng du bhu ser po/ phyogs bcu'i nyi ma'i steng du hu re re/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug gtor 'khor los skyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gzhan rje mthar byed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma mthar byed dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngo sangs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba sngo skya ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lto nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du stobs po che dud nag rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hū mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes mthing nag gshun shing bsnams pa/ hū mdzad ma yin pa gzhan thams cad phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams ni cher khros pa ste/ sku sbom zhing thung ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o//gzhan rnams ni rol pa'i khro bo ste/ cung zad 'dzus pa/ sku 'khrang zhing grim pa/dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo bcu gcig bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa la ye shes kyi khro bo'i —63—

tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX oṃ badzra ni ri te hūX khaX swāhā/oṃ badzra ni wi te hūX khaX swāhā/ oṃ sarba saX sho dha ni swāhā/ dzaXhuX baX hoX khaX raX mahā arghaX pra ca swāhā/ oṃ badzra ngu khye nas shasta'i bar gyis mar/ dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX oṃ badzra bha wa a khiñtsa huX/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gzhin rje mthar byed la rnam par snang mdzad/ padma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ g.yin thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ na maXs manta brnya/ nāX/ na maXs manta dharmā ṇaX/ na maXs manta saX ghā nāX/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaX ka ra/ oṃ pra juX gī ra/ badzra ursha ṣa tsakra brti sarba yant+ra man tra mū la karma brgyu nāX/ tā ḍa naX/ gī la nāX bā/ ma ma kṛ te/ ye na ke na tsi ta kri taX/ tang sarba na tu/ tshinda tshinda/ bhinda bhinda/ tsi ri tsi ri/gi ri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūX huX hūX hūX huX huX huX huX hūX hūX/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pa ci rigs pa bzlas so/ /de nas/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gal te zhi bar ma gyur na/ de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus ཿngas bar bgyi'o/ /ngag ཿnga bar bgyi'o/ /yid ཿnga bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig /stobs brlag par gyur cig /rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur —64—

cig /des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig /des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de'i sha la za bar gyur cig /sbyor ba ngan pa byas pa'i 'bras bu byed pa po de nyid la 'byung bar gyur cig /gnod byed thams cad ni wā ra ya hu phaṭa/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du brlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hū hū hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ bsrung ba'i 'khor le'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yan lag drug dang ldan pa ste/ de yang / e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang cung zad dmar ba/ gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa/ de'i nang du/ ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po ya gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ra gyi mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po dkar po ba gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po la gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhu las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bhu gyis mtshan pa/de'i steng gi bar snang du/ o ā hu ho dmar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa ni bar do'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa yang rnam par shes pa de'i snang ba tsam ste/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la dra ba dang phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i za ra tshags dang pu shus brgyan pa/—65—

rtsig pa'i phyi rol tu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta bab bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang /'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlud gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i/ gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod rṣa po brgyad ni/ shar tu gtum drag /lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu dgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu 'jigs byed mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa'o/ khreng gi rtsa ba na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin/ lhor gzhin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlud lha'o/ /de dag tu ro mgo bo bcad pa dang / dpyangs pa dang / bsnyal ba dang / gsal shing gi phug pa dang / mgo bo dang / keng rus dang / lce spyang dang / khwa dang / lug pa dang / bya rgod dang / ro langs rnams phe zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs par byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / yi dwags dang /sha za dang / spyo byed dang / brjed byed dang / mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma —66—

rnams dang / gzhan yang zhing skyong ba dang / klu dang / sprin dang / chu dang / me dang / mchod rten dang / bsgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lto ser/nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngon po'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/drag po nag po rnams nyal thabs su bkram pa'i gdan dang / 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nyi dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gzhin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag bzang rigs dud kha rnams 'byel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ni la ya badzra su bhā wa utpa ko3haX/ de dag ni pho brang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ste dang po'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i yī/ u ā/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/e i/ o au/ aX āX phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khotshor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha spu/ ya ra la wa ḍa khyu/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis bar du/ hūX las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la huX gis mtshan —67—

pa/ de'i g.yon du a las gri gug sngon nag yu ba la a gis mtshan pa ste de dag so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang yos pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ mche ba'i myu gu bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ hū gi sgra sgrog cing 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung pa'i/g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/de gnyis kyis yum la 'byud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal dkar/ drug pa na skyes pa rang mdog/bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa/g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlud gi lha ljang khu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gi shin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor sbyin ser po/ mi mgo sno pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la thal bas nye bar byugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang pa dang / rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ sgeg cing —68—

dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje ngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu brgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khu/da pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āXlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze 'khru la āXs mtshan pa/ oX padma su kha dhwa ra mahā rā ga su khaX da da tsa khung ā nan da bha ga bi shwa huX hūX hūX ka rlaX ku ru ṣa me/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la huX gis mtshan pa/ oX badzra mahā dre ṣa tsa shun ā nan da dā ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka rā so na tha huX hūX huX ka rlaX ku ru ṣa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padma ra babs pa thig le brgyad du gyur pa rnams/ gaX rtsa baX ghaX paX shaX laX ḍaX zhes pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur/ de rnams lha mo brgyad du gyur pa/yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma sa g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bee ta lī ser mo/ g.yas rus —69—

sbal g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byang du lha sma rī ljang khu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puska sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge /g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shā bā rī dkar mo g.yas lce spyang ngam/ dge slong / g.yon stobar gsil 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang gcer bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon rkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bar snang gi oṃ āXhuX hoX dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa yongs su bkug /yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padma ra babs pa'i rkyen gyis/ yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi thig ler gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra su bhā wa utpa ko3haX/ glu'i bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puska sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas//kyai rdo rje khyed bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhi nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid —70—

la bzhugs sam ci/ khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /g.yung mo bdag ni sems sgrim pas/ /bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /zhes bskul bas/ thig le de nyid hūX dang aX sngon po/ 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de zhu ba las bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/rtsa ba'i zhal mthil nag /g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ steng zhal dud kha/zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa/ nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa skya'i bar sngar ba bskyed/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re de rnams kyi steng du huX aX gaX rtsa baX ghaX paX shāX laX ḍaX/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang / bcud kyi sems can lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu rang la thim/ mig tu maX las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar daX las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon po/snar paX las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ khar rāX las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar i las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte ba'am snying gar naX las bdag med rdo rje ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āXlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar huX las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i huX las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyi rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i —71—

tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ oṃ e hre hi bha ga wān/ mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX zhes brjod cing / spro na 'dir yang mchod bstod bya bsdu na mi dgos so/ /oṃ badzra go rī a karṣa ya dzaX oṃ badzra tso rī pra be shā ya huX/ oṃ badzra bee ta lī ban dha baX/ oṃ badzra lha sma rī wa shaX ku ru hoX de dag ni rjes su gas pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ste gnyis pa'o// //slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūX las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gde/gas pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug /khro bo bcu 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX zhes brjod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs//yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams//thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsole// /tso( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi 'dzin tu maX/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po spyin/ /oX badzi bhā wa a bhi tañtsa hūX/ zhes gsung zhing / sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo —72—

rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang / dbang bzhi thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum dang go rī dang puska sī la mi bskyod pa/ tso rī dang shā bā rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bee ta lī dang tsaṇḍasnyi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lha sma rī dang sho sti ni la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta ba dzñā swa bhā wa utpa ko3ha/ skabs 'dir lus dkyil gyis dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang lus dkyil dang ma 'brel ba'i dbang bzhi chu rgyun gcig ma byed par spro na ni gong ma'i gsung du lta'o/ /de dag ni dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ste gsum pa'o// //nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ 'bru gsum gyis myang / o sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bhā wa utpa ko3ha/ zhes brjod do/ /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag ste bzhi pa'o// //dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes sogs kyis mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā utpa ko3ha/ /zhes brjod/ /de ni mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ste lnga pa'o// //khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga twa sdu ti badzra spyo bhā wa utpa ko3ha/ zhes brjod/ bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ste drug pa'o// //—73—

gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ g.yin du shes par bya'o/ /mnyam par ma bzhug pa'i rnal 'byor la brgyad las/ dang po dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po la/ /byams pa'i thugs kyis sku lus gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni rnam par bzhi zhes brjod/ /zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid/ /gug skyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo nyid/ /rdo rje gsum gyi dag pa'i spyan/ /gzugs phung go rir mug da pa ste/ /tshor ba la ni chom rkun ma/ /'du shes ro langs ma yin te/ /'du byed lha sma rī rab grags/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /sa ni puska phyir bshad de/ /chu khams rngon pa ma zhes brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna che'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa'o/ /dur khrod brgyad ni/ rnam par shes pa brgyad dag pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni bdud bzhi bcom pa'i ye shes so/ /zhes brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa la/ bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ aṣṭa na nā ya/ skra tre rbhe ka sha brtu ne/ tsa shun bi sha ti ne bhā ya/ kho ḍa sha bhu dza ya/ kriṣṭha dzi mū ta ba pu ṣe ka pā la mā la a ne ka bhā ri ṇi/ utpa ta gu ra tsitta ya/ a khyen du da nyi ṇa/ oṃ mā ra ya mā ra ya/kā ra ya kā ra ya/ ga rdza ya ga rdza ya/ ta rnga la ya tardza ya/ 3ga ṣa ya yeg ṣa ya/ sa bha sa —74—

ga rā na/ ban dha ban dha/ nā ga aṣṭa kwan/ gro hā gro hā/ sha trun ha hā hi hi hu hu he hai ho ho haX haXphaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ badzra ka rta ri he badzra ye huX hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ āX.āX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āXnaX badzra ni na yo huX phaṭa swāhā/ bdag med ma'i 'o/ /oṃ āXgaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ skye( āXrtsa hūX phaṭa swāhā/ tsho( āXbaX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ tsho( āXghaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ skye( āXpaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ skye rna āXyi zhuX huX phaṭa swāhā/ skye rdzo āXlaX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ hma( āXḍaX huX phaṭa swāhā/ rgyas pa ni/ oX āXgaX badzra go rī huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de nasaskabs 'dir gtor ma mi gtong na/ gsum pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i 'khor lor gyur/ 'od du zhu bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de 'od du zhu gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa la/ de 'od du zhu lha mo brgyad la thim/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim/ rang gi zhal phyag lhag ma rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ de yang 'od gsal du zhugs/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang rang nyid phyag gnyis par gyur/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje nas/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ 'gro ba thams cad dpal he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'khod par shog /ces sogs/ smon lam btab ste/ spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// //bzhi pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma rnams chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ spyo bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharmaXsu bhā wa —75—

shurnyo3ha/ stong pa'i ngang las ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla ga sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ā las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/shar du go las ba glang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha/byang du ha las glang po che'i sha /dbus su na las mi'i sha kha de rnams re re'i steng du/ bar du bi las dri chen/ lhor ra las rakta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/byang du mā las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bhu bhu me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor a mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dzi so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kha bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hū chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis/ a ā/ i yī/u mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e e/ o au/ a a g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la/ oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du blta ba/ de'i steng du ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hu las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hū gis mtshan pa rdo rje'i lte ba'i hū las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog/rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bskol ba/ 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song ba/ oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hu la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags/ yang hu las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag —76—

pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon nas rdo rje'i hū la thim pas/ rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas/ sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te/ kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hu ha ho hru zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis baḥs/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du/ pa pa pa las padma 'dab brgyad re re/ steng gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ o dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sku rdo rje/shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug khar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lto nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bhring gi ṇi/ byang shar du karti ka ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ bar gyi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la/ hū dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du brgya byin/ lhor gzhin rje/nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod spyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'og gi padma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la ā dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar ltor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du padma/ byang shar du padma wo —77—

po ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad kyang padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i yum gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la 'dres/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la 'dres/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la 'dres te gnyis su med par gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ yang rang gi snying ga'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje dang bcas pas rnam par/ oṃ e hre hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra kā ya lha ka tsitta oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX.oṃ badzra go rī a kar khri ya dzaX oṃ badzra tso rī pra bee sha ya hūX/ oX badzra bee ta lī ban dha baX/ oṃ badzra ga sma rī ba shaX ku ru hoX gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaX bco / ma ldan de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun/ /bco me ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyod kyis 'di la dbang bskur pa stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje dbang bskur chen po spyin/ /oṃ badzre bha wa a bhi ski ñtsa huX/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang —78—

bskur bas/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / dri ma thams cad dag /dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gtso bo yab yum go rī dang puska sī la mi bskyod pa/ tso rī dang shā wā rī la rnam par snang mdzad/ bee ta lī dang tsaṇḍalī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lha sma rī dang toX bhi nī la 'od dpag med/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes brjod/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka /zhes pa nas/ ka ya lha ka tsitta/ oṃ badzra ni ri te hūX khaX swāhā/ zhes sogs kyi chu bzhi phul/ de nas pad bskor bya zhing ngag tu/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā ka ru ṇi ka he badzra sa pa ri wā ra kā ya ltuka tsitta oṃ inda dza ma/ dza la/ dzakṣa/ bhu da/ bsni bā u rakṣa/ tsanda/ su spyo mā ta/ bā spa/ta la/ sa tā laX aṣṭa sarba swāhā/ zhes brjod/rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ i daX ba li bhañdza dzi gha phulla dhu pa/ maX sa bi gha a spa/ sa ba kadzdza sma bhā kha rnyi khu ṇi phe ḍa ga da/ tsho( a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX a du nursha / sno tā ta/ oṃ āXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs pas 'bul lo/ /de nas tso rna bha ga wān zhes pa nas/ kā ya lha ka tsitta/oX badzra pukhye āXhūX/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke /garnye/ nai be skye/ shabha āXhuX/zhes pas phyi mchod dang / oṃ āXhuX/ zhes pas nang bdud rtsis mchod/ de nas dril bu bsil wo / dkar mo ri dwags zhes sogs lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma go sogs dang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod//rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni —79—
